verdict.rationale: Angular's component model (with dependency injection, Signals for fine-grained local state, and modular composition) directly supports encapsulated components with local state composed into complex UIs, corroborated by first-party docs and hands-on community reports confirming components are 'encapsulated and truly reusable.' missing for 10: independent benchmarks/examples of large-scale composition, and some community comments note past performance/opinionation issues with complex state management at scale.
